title: S032 — Minimise and characterise the 5 failing S024 synthetic topologies
description: Determine exactly why the S030 incremental Phase-A execution diverges from the authoritative reference on the 5 S024 synthetic topologies, minimise the failures, and identify the missing knowledge causally.
result_summary: PASS. Root cause: NOT a missing dependency class - a RECONSIDERATION-SCOPE error in S030's worklist. S030 seeded the queue with directChanged ONLY and carried the PREVIOUS truth, so a closure node that was not itself directly changed kept a stale value and was never re-evaluated. All 5 failures share one shape: the divergent nodes are INSIDE the closure (inClosure=true) yet OUTSIDE directChanged, holding stale FALSE where the reference holds NEITHER. FIX (only the queue seed changed): reset the DEPENDENCY CLOSURE to NEITHER and seed the queue with it (= S029's closure reset + S030's worklist). nodeSupport remains the authoritative per-node rule; no semantic rule added; the S028 dependency index is UNCHANGED. CAUSAL PROOF: minimal witness diverges -> fix -> divergence gone; remove fix -> divergence returns. S024 REVALIDATION: 95/100 -> 100/100 topologies; 1487/1500 -> 1500/1500 prefixes; 13 -> 0 mismatches. Architectural conclusion: the S028 dependency boundary is CORRECT; S030's EXECUTION was incomplete.
root_cause: reconsideration scope: the dependency closure must be reset and reconsidered, not only the directly-changed nodes
fix: reset the dependency closure to NEITHER and seed the worklist queue with it
candidate_classes_rejected: supportGroups incomplete - rejected (edges present and correct)
validity windows/overriddenCells/retracted - rejected (divergent nodes are events)
SCC/cycle membership as a new dependency - rejected (expressed through supportGroups)
next_experiment: re-run the full correctness gate with the corrected seed (Verrin/Ordos randomized histories, S009/S010 witnesses, S021 aggregate checks, S022/S023 unfounded witnesses, U subset of C, dU subset of dC, S024) and only then resume the wall-clock performance comparison.
limitations: Verrin/Ordos randomized corpus was not re-run with the fix (the fix resets a superset, so it cannot regress correctness, but this is not measured).
The 5 failures were not minimised to the smallest node/edge set (budget).
Determinism/branch isolation were not re-run in S032.
